title: Unstored calculation with host round trip
description: Performance rule — an unstored calculation field calls Get(CurrentHostTimestamp) and is placed on layouts. Claris documents that every display of such a field triggers an additional network access to the host.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: An unstored calculation is re-evaluated on every display. When the formula calls Get(CurrentHostTimestamp), each evaluation asks the server for its clock — in a list view or portal this multiplies across every visible record and every refresh.
rule.remediation: Replace the display use with a stored value written at a defined moment (auto-enter, script), or restrict the field to contexts that render few records at a time.

meta.name: Unstored calculation with host round trip
meta.author: fm-lab rules
meta.description: Only fields that are actually placed on at least one layout are reported — the Claris-documented cost is per display, not per definition. The formula is matched case-insensitively on CurrentHostTimestamp and its German display name SystemuhrzeitstempelHost. Only the field's own calculation slot is checked: auto-enter and validation formulas evaluate on write, not on render.
